EOS: primary tokenizer.eos_token_id probability/logit; rank=1+number strictly greater; secondary canonical stop_ids aggregate probability
distributions: raw model next-token logits softmax; NO presence penalty/temperature/topk/topp because these are model mechanism metrics, not resampling
final_hidden: model-level final normalized lm_head input, existing CAYLEY.relative_mse; no fake layerwise hidden
functional_metric: existing sparse_probe.state_metric relative_l2 on GDN linear_attn.out_proj last-position output; same hook point as sparse_probe.OutputCapture
indexing: distribution j predicts generated token[j]; prefill predicts j=0; consuming shared token[j-1] predicts j; t_star requires exactly t_star decode tokens; window [max(0,t_star-64),t_star)
layer_flag_operationalization: EXPLORATORY: for each State/Functional region candidate requires B positive deltas >=7/10, uniquely largest among 3 region deltas >=7/10, group median>0. PRESENT only same unique candidate in both families and corresponding positive/dominance conjunction <=3/6 in each C/D control group. Any family candidate without this closure=>MIXED; no family candidate=>NOT_PRESENT.
layer_region_reduction: within sample median paired C7-C6R relative_l2 across 8 layers; then category sample distribution
missing_divergence: NONE kept in accounting, primary/window metrics excluded; no replacement point; sequence exhaustion without unequal token is separately labelled
next_category: A only at least one primary/window flag and specificity PRESENT and not all active directional rates >=4/6 in both-wrong; else B only layer PRESENT; otherwise C (no stable specific prefix explanation, including control-common patterns)
panel_assignment: parent panel row ordinal (0-based) % 4; every condition on that physical UUID
prefix: original common generated tokens [0:t_star]; identical rendered canonical prompt all arms

prefix_flags.accumulation: 10 B; >=7 positive per-sample median window deltaKL OR >=7 negative per-sample median window deltaMargin

qdq: original formal.quantize_c128 after each decode; output logits/functional precede current QDQ, captured state is post-QDQ for next decode
specificity_operationalization: Prospectively conservative: no B primary/window flag => NOT_PRESENT; else PRESENT only if every active directional signal has <=3/6 both-correct controls in same direction; otherwise MIXED. Always report C/D exact counts; no significance meaning.
state_basis: q/k transform H then Delta unchanged; inverse physical state H @ Delta @ native state, orientation reused from sparse_probe.physical_state for C5/C6
state_metric: existing sparse_probe.state_metric relative_l2; post-QDQ persistent physical-state drift vs FP at j=t_star
storage_policy: no full vocabulary disk tensors; transient CPU FP window logits <=65 positions; only t_star state/output/hidden reference tensors transient; metrics only saved
topk_ties: stable descending logit, ascending token ID
